title: RAFT: Forcing RAG to Actually Read

beats.text: Feeding retrieved documents into language models usually fails. The AI skims the text and hallucinates anyway.
beats.visual_focus: Chalkboard showing a stack of retrieved documents feeding into a transformer, sparking red error warnings.

visual_blueprint.title: THE RETRIEVAL ILLUSION
visual_blueprint.sub: Prompt context flooded with unranked context snippets

motif_params.title: THE RETRIEVAL ILLUSION
motif_params.sub: Prompt context flooded with unranked context snippets

beats.text: Standard RAG treats prompts like an open-book exam packed with decoys. The model panics. Trusting noisy distractor documents over actual ground truth.
beats.visual_focus: Grid of memory blocks where red distractor tokens outnumber and overshadow the single green gold document.

visual_blueprint.title: DISTRACTOR INVASION
visual_blueprint.sub: Noisy irrelevant snippets drowning out oracle facts

motif_params.title: DISTRACTOR INVASION
motif_params.sub: Noisy irrelevant snippets drowning out oracle facts

beats.text: Enter RAFT. Retrieval Augmented FineTuning. Instead of hoping the model reads. We actively train it in adversarial open-book environments.
beats.visual_focus: A glowing filtration funnel stripping away gray distractor documents while highlighting the target reference document in emerald green.

beats.text: RAFT forces the model to locate the gold document. Cite the key sequence verbatim. And construct chain-of-thought reasoning before answering.
beats.visual_focus: Chalkboard showing verbatim quotation lines highlighted in gold, branching directly into step-by-step reasoning nodes.
